title: Tacit Context Card
description: Ephemeral single-turn interpretive output produced by the Tacit Swarm Pre-Pass. Governs Abigail's response planning for one turn. Does not mutate Store 1. Not persisted unless separately authorized as Store 2 evidence.
status: DOCTRINE_ONLY — runtime schema, activation not authorized (see ACTIVATION_PHASES.md)

card_id.description: UUID for this card instance. Not stored unless Store 2 is authorized.

request_type.description: Classified request type. Determines pre-pass tier and agent invocation policy.

tacit_interpretation.description: 1–3 sentence statement of what the user is actually asking, beyond the literal words. Written from tacit/interpretive perspective.

relevant_prior_context.description: Tags or brief references to doctrine, memory, or prior context that applies to this turn.

relevance.description: How directly this context affects the response.

source.description: Optional: where this context comes from (e.g. 'store2_session_pattern', 'operator_doctrine', 'conversation_history').

hidden_assumptions.description: Things the user assumed but did not say, or things Abigail might miss if she reads the request literally.

missing_scope.description: Scope items that would be required to proceed fully but are absent. Triggers escalation_required if critical.

risk_notes.description: Brief governance or safety notes relevant to this turn. Not a replacement for Sentinel/OverWatch verdicts.

recommended_route.description: Suggested response routing: department ID, agent ID, 'direct_response', 'operator_clarification', or 'escalate'.

allowed_agents.description: Agent IDs permitted to run for this turn. Empty means no agents beyond Abigail herself.

forbidden_agents.description: Agent IDs explicitly blocked for this turn. TKR-01 is always listed here unless operator has separately authorized elicitation.

memory_policy.description: How this card and its outputs may be persisted. Default: ephemeral + store1_blocked.

store1_mutation.description: Always false. Pre-pass never initiates Store 1 mutation.

response_guidance.description: Concise framing hint for Abigail's response planner. Not a script — a lens.

confidence.description: Pre-pass confidence in the classification and interpretation. Below 0.60 triggers escalation_required.

escalation_required.description: True if the pre-pass cannot classify with confidence ≥ 0.60, or if required scope is missing.

prepass_tier.description: Tier of pre-pass invoked for this turn.

agents_invoked.description: Actual agent IDs invoked during the pre-pass (for audit).

latency_ms.description: Pre-pass wall-clock latency in milliseconds. Target: < 500ms.

examples.tacit_interpretation: User wants a straightforward factual answer. No hidden complexity or doctrine constraint applies. Abigail should respond directly and concisely without over-explaining.
hidden_assumptions: User expects a single-sentence answer, not a full explanation.
examples.response_guidance: Short, direct answer. No agent routing needed.

examples.tacit_interpretation: User is asking for remote Python roles, but the deeper want is sustainable income that fits a recovery-friendly schedule with mission alignment. Veteran and technical background should inform fit criteria. Live current listings are required — tacit framing alone is not sufficient.
hidden_assumptions: User implies stability over salary maximization.
Mission-aligned employer may matter more than title.
Recovery-friendly hours (no overnight, no heavy travel) are an unstated constraint.
risk_notes: Do not invent job listings. EIR-01 external lookup required for current openings.
examples.response_guidance: Frame the search around fit criteria first. Note recovery and veteran constraints. Flag that live listings will come from EIR-01 lookup — do not fabricate.
